papers_and_supporting_note.scope: Universal characterization for products of two finite embedded rational balanced pure graphs with positive real weights and rank-one local nonnegative relation cones: every positive-growth continuous real-PA actual-PC reference and every bounded continuous real-PA obstacle have a finite rational-domain PAPC raw envelope, explicit uniform decreasing regularization and complete recursive contact if and only if at least one factor is unbranched. Entire original graphs with cycles, ends and disconnected components retained. For any two branched factors there is an actual regularizable PAPC envelope with full contact integral -8ab, retaining all saturated indices and arbitrary real local scales. Original fixed-reference arbitrary-balanced-pair classification remains open.

continued_goal: All original atoms remain open; further research proceeds in small batches.
